subject: Staged acceptance & capacity plan for AWS marketplace renewal
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@atlashealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@atlas-health.com
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity request for AWS Marketplace - Atlas Health

Hi Chloe,

Hope you’re well. Atlas is planning our yearly renewal and we expect a ~2.8x increase in inference consumption over the next 12 months due to a new rollout in Q4. We want to renew via AWS Marketplace (private offer) if possible and add staged capacity so we can ramp without interrupting service.

Questions:
- Can Redwood do a private offer that allows a staged acceptance (50% initial, +25% at month 4, +25% at month 8)?
- What billing cadence does that trigger in Marketplace (invoice timing / effective acceptance dates)?
- Any paperwork you need from Procurement to start the PO / private-offer flow?

I attached the draft PO our procurement team prepared (Atlas_PO_2027-07-25.pdf). We need to close this by mid-August to hit our deployment timeline.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Laura Chen
Head of Procurement, Atlas Health
laura.chen@atlashealth.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: Atlas_PO_2027-07-25.pdf (pdf, 98KB)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity request for AWS Marketplace - Atlas Health

Hi Laura — thanks for the note and the PO.

Short answer: yes, we can do a staged-acceptance private offer on AWS and align invoices to each acceptance milestone. High level plan we typically use:
- Create AWS private offer with staged acceptance milestones matching your proposed percentages.
- Each acceptance triggers a marketplace acceptance event and an invoice for that accepted capacity.
- We can set the effective start date of the first acceptance to your renewal date and schedule the later acceptances as optional ramp confirmations (Atlas signs initial acceptance + the later increments are mechanical acceptances executed by Redwood once usage thresholds are reached or on agreed dates).

Questions for your procurement team so I can draft the private offer:
- Confirm exact renewal start date (you mentioned mid-August — can you provide a target date?)
- Confirm if Atlas prefers all invoices to bill to the same billing account or separated by milestone
- Any required legal verbiage or PO number fields we should include in the private offer file (your PO had a reference number?)

I’m looping Marissa on this thread to confirm commercial terms (discount bands for the uplift) and Rafael for billing cadence. I’ll draft the private offer template and a proposed acceptance schedule and send it back for signature.

If helpful, we can do a 30-minute call this week to lock the dates.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity request for AWS Marketplace - Atlas Health

Thanks for looping me in, Chloe.

We can support the staged acceptance you requested. Proposed commercial / operational plan below (aimed at minimizing procurement friction while preserving unit economics):

- Term: 12 months from initial acceptance date
- Acceptance schedule (proposed):
  * Acceptance A (50%) — effective 2027-08-15 (initial renewal)
  * Acceptance B (25%) — scheduled for 2027-12-01 (auto-accept unless Atlas opts out 14 days prior)
  * Acceptance C (25%) — scheduled for 2028-04-01 (same auto-accept language)
- Pricing: existing rates for baseline; uplift band for new capacity (we propose 18% discount on incremental capacity if Atlas commits to the staged schedule).
- Billing: AWS Marketplace invoices per acceptance event to Atlas’ registered billing account. Redwood will also issue a consolidated credit/invoice report to your AP team after each acceptance to aid reconciliation.
- PO fields: please include Atlas PO number and a billing contact email (we need both to set up the private offer).

I attached a short private-offer template and a sample acceptance schedule for procurement to review. Rafael — can you confirm the marketplace invoice timeline and whether Redwood will need to accept the offer in the AWS console on Atlas’ behalf or if Atlas will accept from their marketplace account?

Laura — if this looks OK I’ll prepare the private-offer file (xlsx) and route for signature; we can also send a DocuSign if preferred.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Thanks everyone — quick update and next steps.

1) Laura / Atlas procurement: I uploaded the private-offer file to DocuSign and included the PO fields you requested. Link: https://www.docusign.net/atlsh1
2) Rafael: per Marissa’s note, Redwood will create the private offer and we will accept the initial 50% on Atlas’ behalf once we have the signed DocuSign. Subsequent acceptances will be executed per the scheduled dates unless Laura flags an opt-out. Rafael — can you confirm you’ll watch the marketplace acceptance events and trigger the reconciliations to Atlas AP?
3) Invoices / timing: AWS will generate invoices on each acceptance event; Redwood will forward the invoice PDF and a reconciliation summary to procurement@atlas-health.com within 48 hours of acceptance.
4) Timeline: target initial acceptance/first invoice on 2027-08-15.
